summary: Portillo’s Appoints Kevin Kalicak as Chief Financial Officer Kevin Kalicak, Chief Financial Officer CHICAGO, Aug. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Portillo’s (NASDAQ: PTLO), the fast-casual restaurant concept known for serving Chicago-style favorites for more than 60 years, today announced the appointment of Kevin Kalicak as Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer, effective September 7, 2026.
